fields.Name: T178 - Paginate Enrollments Grid
fields.Description: Verifies grid pagination on a large entity (Enrollments, ~900 rows).

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Enrollments' entity grid — type 'Enrollments' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click it (or, if the search is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Enrollments). It has ~900 records spread across many pages, ~100 per page. Use the grid's pagination control at the BOTTOM (the page navigation / next-page arrow) to advance to the next page (page 2). Verify a different page of enrollment rows is shown. Do not repeatedly toggle the same control. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Enrollments entity grid is displayed with multiple pages of rows
The bottom pagination control advanced to a different page of rows
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
